acceptanceCriteria: From the docs index and console, the current ticket queue is discoverable; an empty redirect directory cannot be read as zero pending work.
body:
Comprehensive expert audit 2026-09-26, DOC-03. Source 2961076fc0b78bfab743578f2ef5c17006be058a.

docs/README describes docs/agent-memory as six cross-session backlogs; the console labels and serves the redirects as Backlogs and calls them pending work. AGENTS says the live queue is `.taskman` and those Markdown pages are redirects only. A user can infer an empty backlog while open tickets exist.

Source: docs/README.md:40; AGENTS.md:90; docs/agent-memory/bugs.md:10; internal/console/server.go:438; internal/console/render.go:173; docs/specs/local-admin-console-v0.md:14

Observed checks: "Read all six Markdown pages: each is a 16-line redirect, with no ticket list. Ticket index includes OPEN tickets including V1-0344/0345."

Owning contract: "AGENTS.md Agent routing; LAC-V0-006..008 require source attribution and no false empty state."

Correction: Update docs/README and console navigation/copy to identify these as historical redirects; point the active work route to the task-store board/roadmap, preserving explicit unavailable state when no store is attached.

Report: .agent-evidence/2026-09-26-comprehensive-audit.md; original reports and evidence: .agent-evidence/audit-20260926/. Focused checks plus independent review are required for repair; any native release qualification needs the selected candidate and owner-dispatched run. No qualification or promotion is implied by this ticket.
title: Backlog navigation sends readers to six redirect pages as if they were current
